name: Recraft
summary: Raster and SVG vector image generation, editing, vectorizing, background removal and upscaling.

api_token.description: A Recraft API token (recraft.ai/app/api/api-keys); the account needs a positive API units balance. Sent as a Bearer token.

notes: Every call is paid in API units (1 USD = 1,000 units); the response's credits field reports the units charged.
Pass images as URLs or data URLs (data:image/png;base64,...) in JSON; multipart uploads are not used here.
Result image URLs are temporary (about 24 hours): download what you keep.
Rate limits: 100 images per minute and 5 requests per second per user.
Generation and edit calls answer {data: [{image_id, url}]}; vectorize, remove background, upscale and erase answer a single {image: {...}} instead.
Only send parameters the chosen model supports: style, negative_prompt and text_layout are V2/V3 only; style references are not for V4.1 Flash.
Error bodies may be plain text (a bad token gives 401 'request unauthorized').

endpoints.name: Generate images from a prompt
endpoints.summary: Raster or SVG images from text, with optional style, colors and size.

prompt.description: Text prompt; up to 10,000 characters on V4/V4.1, 1,000 on V2/V3.
prompt.example: two race cars on a track

model.description: Model id; default recraftv4_1. E.g. recraftv4_1_flash, recraftv4_1_vector, recraftv4_1_pro, recraftv4_styles, recraftv3, recraftv2_vector.

size.description: Prefer a w:h ratio (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 3:2, ...); an exact WxH must be one of the model's sizes.

style_id.description: UUID of a style made for the same model; not combinable with style references.

style_reference_urls.description: 1 to 10 image URLs or data URLs that define a style for this request (costs 0.005 USD extra; returns style_id).

style_match.description: flexible or precise on V4/V4.1; regular on V2/V3.

style.description: V2/V3 curated style name, e.g. Photorealism, Illustration, Vector art.

text_layout.description: V3 only: [{text, bbox}] with one word per item and bbox corners as 0-1 coordinates from the top-left.

controls.description: {colors: [{rgb: [r,g,b]}], background_color: {rgb: [...]}}; V3 also artistic_level (0-5) and no_text.

image_format.description: Raster output format: webp (default) or png. Vector output is always SVG.

notes: A read over POST that spends units per image: recraftv4_1_flash 0.007 USD, recraftv4_1 0.035, recraftv4_1_vector 0.08, recraftv4_1_pro 0.21 (see the model table).

endpoints.name: Generate an image from an image and prompt
endpoints.summary: A new image based on an input image, steered by a prompt and strength.

image_url.description: Input image URL or data URL (under 20 MB, 256 to 4096 px a side).

prompt.description: What the new image should show.

strength.description: 0 to 1; 1 is least similar to the input.

model.description: V3, V4 or V4.1 model (not Flash); default recraftv4_1.

notes: A read over POST that spends units (0.04 USD per image, 0.08 with V3 per the docs table).

endpoints.name: Vectorize a raster image
endpoints.summary: Converts a PNG, JPG or WEBP into an editable SVG.

image_url.description: Input image URL or data URL.

notes: A read over POST; 0.01 USD per request. The answer is {image: {image_id, url}}, not a data array.

endpoints.name: Remove an image's background
endpoints.summary: Transparent cutout of a PNG, JPG, WEBP or SVG (SVG in, SVG out).

image_url.description: Input image URL or data URL.

notes: A read over POST; 0.01 USD per request. The answer is {image: {...}}.

endpoints.name: Upscale an image (crisp)
endpoints.summary: Higher resolution with the same content.

image_url.description: Input image URL or data URL (min side 32 px).

notes: A read over POST; 0.004 USD per request. /images/creativeUpscale (0.25 USD) also regenerates detail and faces. The answer is {image: {...}}.

endpoints.name: Enhance a prompt
endpoints.summary: Expands a short prompt into a richer image description.

prompt.description: Prompt to expand, up to 2,000 characters.

notes: A read over POST; 0.01 USD per request. Returns {enhanced_prompt}.

endpoints.name: Get account and unit balance
endpoints.summary: User id, email, name and remaining API units.
